CoreFlow · AM

Gut and Microbiome Foundation

CoreFlow is a bio-optimized GI protocol centered on butyrate support, microbiome balance, digestion, and foundational gut health.

Set expectations

Give Your Body Time to Adapt

Health is a journey, not a quick fix. We recommend using your selected Core system consistently for at least 90 days to give your body time to adapt and experience the full benefits of the routine.

Days 1–14Settle into the routine. Start low on tablets if you prefer.
Days 15–60Build to the full serving. Stay consistent.
Day 90Your first real checkpoint on the routine.
Start with one tablet if you like

CoreBlue and CoreGreen packaging may recommend between one and five tablets daily. PERGA’s full recommended Foundation serving is five tablets of each. The lower range allows you to gradually introduce the products. If you experience mild digestive or detox-related discomfort, begin with one tablet and gradually increase toward the full serving.

Don’t overcomplicate timing

PERGA provides suggested morning and evening directions, but you don’t need to overthink it. Consistency is more important than perfect timing. The products may be taken together if that makes the routine easier to maintain.
